title: K5 cut-cycle mixed common-order covariance universality audit
scope: Linearized Gaussian K5 surrogate only. Tests whether the p=6 density exponent found in Iter420 survives generic positive-definite cut/cycle cross-correlations under one common cycle scaling order.
construction: In an orthonormal cut/cycle basis Q=[Qc,Qz], draw a full 10x10 SPD seed H. Define D_eta=diag(I_4, eta I_6) and Sigma_eta = Q D_eta H D_eta Q^T. This includes O(eta) cut-cycle covariance and O(eta^2) cycle covariance while remaining SPD.

frozen_predictions.small_eigenvalue_scaling: six eigenvalues scale asymptotically as eta^2
frozen_predictions.large_eigenvalue_scaling: four eigenvalues approach finite nonzero limits

profile_variation: 24 deterministic seeds spanning weak through strong cut-cycle mixing and several SPD conditioning regimes; no gate tuning after results.
claim_lock: A PASS establishes only universality of the K5 eta^-6 normalization exponent within this broad congruence-scaled Gaussian regulator class. It does not derive the physical causal EPRL/Toller i-epsilon prescription, does not prove finiteness of the true vertex, and does not close D7 or NEW_REQUIRED.
